newsitem.title: USA: "Evita" among top nominees for Golden Globes.
newsitem.headline: "Evita" among top nominees for Golden Globes.

text.p: "The English Patient", "Evita", "Shine" and "The People vs. Larry Flynt" topped the list of nominees announced on Thursday for the Golden Globe film awards.

Pop star Madonna, who plays the lead role in "Evita," was nominated for best actress in a musical or comedy along with Glenn Close for "101 Dalmations", Frances McDormand for "Fargo", Debbie Reynolds for "Mother" and Barbra Streisand for "The Mirror Has Two Faces."
